mustFind.source: Bell 1964; Aspect 1982; Hensen et al. 2015 loophole-free
mustFind.note: The canonical test. If AGEM misses this, nothing else in this corpus counts.
Requires dim >= 3. Forces every hidden-variable theory to be contextual.
Preparation independence is contested (Gao 2025 argues it is dispensable). Corpus states the objection; AGEM should surface it as an attributed challenge, not resolve it.
Cleanest arity-3 MUS in the corpus. Q/C/S.

mustFind.source: Brukner 2018; Bong et al. 2020 Local Friendliness

mustNotFind.why: de Broglie-Bohm is a consistent position. It pays for Bell with nonlocality and for Kochen-Specker with contextuality. Reporting it as contradictory means the escape routes are not encoded.
Everett is consistent. It pays for Bell and Frauchiger-Renner by denying single_outcome.
Consistent precisely because it omits measurement_independence. Philosophically unattractive is not logically inconsistent, and AGEM must not conflate the two.
QBism escapes PBR by denying there is a lambda to be ignorant about, and escapes Frauchiger-Renner by denying absolute agent_consistency.

These are opposed stances on one axis, not a MUS. If AGEM reports every axis as an arity-2 contradiction it has learned to detect negation, not impossibility. Expected as positions_incompatible, never as corpus contradiction.

openQuestions.note: Does denying observer-independence buy enough to keep both psi-epistemic and locality after PBR and Brukner? Plausibly the most interesting cell in the map.

Retrocausal accounts claim to satisfy Bell's letter by making measurement_independence fail in a temporally-backward way. Whether that is a genuine fourth escape route or a relabelling of superdeterminism is live.
Are there MUSes arising from the CONJUNCTION of two separately-proved theorems that nobody has named? Enumerate all MUSes and diff against mustFind. Any surplus is the result.
